result.brief: 提出 Agentic RSR 框架，将场景重建、策略开发与真机执行通过同一操作任务串联，实现从视频到仿真再到真机的策略迁移。
result.reason: Real-to-sim-to-real scene reconstruction with execution-grounded robot policies; main contribution is robot policy/planning in reconstructed simulation, matching the secondary world-model applications direction.
